caption:
Most leads go cold before anyone calls them back.

Only 17% of service businesses answer a lead within an hour. Leads contacted within 5 minutes close at roughly double the rate.

The gap isn't effort. It's not having the words ready the second a lead comes in.

The Follow-Up Builder fixes that. Answer a few questions about your business and it writes a complete follow-up sequence, texts and emails, so the next lead gets a reply before they call your competitor.

Free. No signup. No card.
